### The Counterpoint
**The Prime-on-site offer still lacks a sales result: About Amazon**
About Amazon asks whether offering Prime delivery on a merchant website increases sales, and the number it publishes is fulfillment mix, not a sales change. Among early merchant adopters, more than 40% of eligible orders on average have shipped with Prime delivery.
Source: https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-mcf-prime-delivery-merchant-websites?utm_source=rss
